reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003 vs K7_C0005 boundary, the current-boundary measurements are well represented: independent two-way spectral agreement is high (ARI 0.925) and within-side affinity (0.316) exceeds between-side affinity (0.106), a within>between contrast. The normalized-cut cost is moderate (0.495), and the union eigengap is candidate_k=1 (leading gap 0.401 at k=1), meaning the union is dominated by the single-cluster resolution. Per guidance, a represented current boundary together with a single-cluster-dominated union is conflicting structural evidence, not automatic evidence against merge; the single-cluster union must not be read as evidence for preserving the two-set boundary. The overall pattern is conflicting and does not by itself determine merge or retention.
reports.cross_evidence_context: Prior native-view affinity_geometry_concordance for this pair was directionally coherent but weak: CT (0.135), RNA (0.051), WSI (0.075), and WXS (0.034) were all weakly positive. That weak native-view support is broadly consistent with the well-represented current boundary seen here, while the single-cluster-dominated union adds a conflicting element. Prior WXS mutation reports describe biological identity of the sets (K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003 VHL-depleted; K7_C0005 BAP1-enriched) but do not bear on boundary representation.
